results.evidence: Retry found no distance figure beyond the single '3.5 miles' already known: the NCMG route page, the countryhighpoints, climberkyle, hike2hike and karl-helser reports give times or gain but no one-way or round-trip mileage (karl-helser gives only a 1.3 mi / 2,300 ft sub-segment). Peakbagger/Mountaineers/SummitPost pages were blocked. Would settle: a GPS track stat (e.g. a Mountaineers route page or a gaia/caltopo track) giving the one-way distance to the col and the summit.

A guide service page says only 'over 4,000 ft' of gain to the summit (plus a few hundred feet on the return), WTA says 4,500 ft; the Mountaineers 5,200 and a hiking site 6,000 were found before. No two sources state the same car-to-car figure, and a computed total is not allowed. Would settle: a second source independently stating ~4,500 ft (or another single figure) car to car for this route.

Two independent sources now agree on the north-ridge facts: a route page says you rappel south off Jaw's Tooth to the Skookum notch from a tat anchor (or downclimb low 5th) and then climb low-5th ridge to Skookum's top, descending 3rd-class gullies on the south side; a separate trip report describes tying back in for the exposed north ridge. So beta/pro_needs (rope, rappel) are right for the north ridge, and rope_type 'none' would be right only for a separate scramble line. The row mixes both (name/grade 'Olivine Scramble' Class 3-4 vs face 'North Ridge', rock_grade 5.4), so which rope fields are wrong depends on which route the row is; no minimal patch settles it. Would settle: an owner decision on whether this row is the north ridge (then rope_type/rope_note/gear change) or the south-side scramble (then beta/pro_needs/face/rock_grade change).

The row is internally consistent (high_point_ft and the summit pin both 6,534). The USGS 1 m point-elevation service reads 6,533.9 ft exactly at the summit pin, and a grid of samples 40-120 m around it all read 6,140-6,360 ft, so the pin sits on the lidar high point. The published 6,480 (state names proposal) and 6,500 (topo list) are 40-ft contour-map figures, and 6,616/5,962 elsewhere refer to other points; nothing supports changing the stored value.

descent_text, hazards and watch_out say never descend Skookum's south-facing slopes, while a route page for the Jaw's Tooth/north ridge line gives the descent as 3rd-class gullies down the south side of the mountain. Only one source states the descent, and it is tied to the route-identity question above. Would settle: a second report of the Skookum descent plus the owner's decision on which route this row describes.

results.fact: Line past Paul Bunyan's Stump in season
results.evidence: Still only one source describes the late-season rock-rib bypass to the SE side of the Colonial Glacier. The NPS climbing-ranger conditions note (Aug 2015) says the Colonial is bare ice and 'would probably have to be climbed mostly on rock', and other reports (Alpine Wanderlust, Hebert, onehikeaweek) do not describe the bypass line. Would settle: a second trip report describing the east-side rib bypass.

Retry reports give ~2 mi to Pyramid Lake and ~1 mi more to the 'Lily Pond' (Alpine Wanderlust) or only times (Hebert, onehikeaweek); none gives the distance to the Colonial moraine camp, so 4.4 vs 5.5 mi for day 1 cannot be settled. Would settle: a GPS track stat to the moraine camp.

results.fact: Height where the glacier is left for the ridge
results.evidence: Lemke left the snow at ~7,800 ft and climbed ~500 ft of class 1-2 rock to the summit scramble; Eric's Base Camp reaches the ridge ~7,700 ft; the Mountaineers route text leaves the snow ~8,100-8,200 ft. The difference appears to be seasonal snow cover and which point is meant (reaching the ridge vs entering the NW gully), so no single figure is supported by two sources for the gully entry. Would settle: a report giving the gully-entry elevation for the climbing_route[1] line.
